content.rendered:
SAVE THE DATE – SCHOOL CARNIVAL – APRIL 20 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM
As we’re sure you’ve heard and hopefully already saved the date for, Archer Glen Elementary is just weeks away from our annual school Carnival, a family-friendly event complete with games, food, raffles and a silent auction.  From an inflatable obstacle course, to a new and improved lollipop tree and a “pick the nose” game as well as old favorites like the fish and soda pop toss, there is literally something for everyone.   Come for the games, stay for dinner and bid on some great silent auction items and all for a good cause.  Last year the event was not only an affordable evening of carnival fun, but successfully raised over $20,000. This year, the funds raised will go toward a rain / sun canopy to allow students year-round access to outdoor recess!  By simply marking your calendars & coming to the Carnival you will be pledging your support.   There are also additional ways to help reach our goal, such as participating in the raffle (look in your Friday folders for tickets and additional information), silent auction or the ever popular wine wall.    More information about The Carnival can be found on the PAC (Parent Advisory Committee) site www.archerglenpac.org  

OR just  Click Here to visit the Carnival homepage
